subject: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@northgate.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Hi all,

Attaching the latest Visual Fencing diagram set (fencing-diagram-v2.svg) and an initial mapping workbook for SIG/CAIQ questions. These focus on the Dedicated and Private deployment patterns we discussed: control-plane segregation, tenant KV cache isolation, egress filtering, and optional air-gapped patterns for on-prem.

What I need from the team:
- Kimberly: confirm whether the control-plane annotations are clear enough for an external security reviewer (I flagged three callouts in the diagram).
- Karthik: please map the diagram callouts to SIG v2026-05 question ids in the attached sig-mapping-table.csv and call out any gaps that need evidence.
- Jordan: inventory any additional network evidence artifacts (flow logs, ACL exports) we should include in the evidence package.

Sarah / Mike: sharing early so you can flag any additional packaging expectations from Northgate. We plan to produce a consolidated evidence bundle and a short explainer doc for your SOC 2 vendor review.

Proposed next steps: internal review by EOD Thursday, sync with Northgate on Friday for any follow-ups.

Attachments: fencing-diagram-v2.svg, sig-mapping-table.csv

Thanks,

— Logan
Logan Wright
Product Security PM | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@northgate.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Logan — thanks for these. Quick notes after a first pass: 

- Diagrams: overall good. Suggest splitting the control-plane narrative into a separate small block (Control Plane: auth, telemetry, and operator access) so external reviewers don't have to parse the service-ring overlays. I added three numbered callouts on page 2 (see redlined svg).
- Callout language: where we say "tenant separation enforced by routing+policies", please add an explicit line about tenant encryption-in-transit across the private interconnect — reviewers tend to look for that language.
- Evidence: Jordan should pull the last 90 days of VPC flow logs and any egress policy change records for the checklist. Those are the usual SIG asks.

I can take the diagram edits and produce an "annotated control-plane appendix" if that helps accelerate the external review.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security Architect | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@northgate.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Uploaded an updated sig-mapping-table.csv that adds a column for "required artifact" and flags whether the control is satisfied by a diagram, config snippet, or runtime evidence. Highlights: 

- SIG QN-30 (network segmentation): diagram + VPC flow logs + ACL export required.
- SIG QN-41 (control-plane access): annotated operator IAM policies + Bastion access logs. For Dedicated we rely on a separate management VPC; I called that out in the mapping and referenced the fencing-diagram-v2.svg callout #2.
- Edge cases: for on-prem Private deployments, we need an additional note around airgap validation steps (we don't ship the agent over the public network). I'll add a short runbook stub to the Drive folder.

Attached: updated sig-mapping-table.csv (v1.1). I'll follow up with a small config excerpt for the management VPC peering policy.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@northgate.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@northgate.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Thanks, Logan — we received the diagram and mapping. A couple quick asks from Northgate's side: 

- Can you provide a single bundled evidence ZIP (diagrams, annotated control-plane appendix, mappings, flow logs extract, ACL exports) for our external assessor? Our timeline is aggressive; target delivery for the bundle by next Wednesday would be ideal.
- Please call out any controls that are "operator-only" (i.e., need manual attestation) — the assessor will mark those differently.

I'll hold Friday's slot for an architecture walk if you want to run through the diagram live. Mike in procurement will follow up separately about any evidence transfer agreements.

Regards,
Sarah Lin
Security Manager | Northgate Analytics
sarah.lin@northgate.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@northgate.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@northgate.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Visual fencing diagrams + SIG mapping for Dedicated/Private

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Kimberly to produce an "Annotated Control-Plane Appendix" (diagram callouts + language for encryption and operator access) — deliverable: annotated_svg_v1.pdf — due Tuesday EOD.
2) Karthik to finalize sig-mapping-table.csv with required artifacts column and a short config excerpt for management VPC peering — due Tuesday EOD.
3) Jordan to export 90d VPC flow logs (redacted where necessary) and ACL change history, and drop into the shared Drive folder.
4) Logan to assemble the evidence bundle (network-evidence-checklist.pdf), upload to Drive, and send a DocuSign link for the mutual action plan (MAF) by Wednesday morning.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Northgate-evidence
DocuSign (MAF): DOCUSIGN:MAF-NORTHGATE-2026-11

Attachments: network-evidence-checklist.pdf

If there are any blockers on timelines, flag now — otherwise we'll aim to hand the consolidated bundle to Sarah's assessor on Wednesday.

Cheers,
— Logan
